subject: general
question: As per the Ministry of Finance, what percentage of India's population filed income tax returns in FY 2023-24?
solution:
The correct answer is __**6.68%**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• As per the Ministry of Finance, only **6**.**68%** of India's population filed income tax returns in the financial year 2023-24.
 
• This statistic highlights the **low tax compliance** rate in India despite a growing population and economy.
 
• The filing of income tax returns is mandatory for individuals whose income exceeds the basic exemption limit specified by the government.
 
• In recent years, the government has taken steps to **expand the tax base**, such as digitization and linking PAN with Aadhaar.
 
• The figure indicates that a large portion of the workforce, particularly in the **informal sector**, remains outside the tax net.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Income Tax in India:**

 
 
• Income tax is a direct tax levied by the government on individuals and entities based on their income.
 
• The tax rates are defined under various slabs, with progressive rates for higher income brackets.
 
• For individuals below 60 years of age, the basic exemption limit is ₹2.5 lakh annually.
 
 
 
• **Reasons for Low Tax Compliance:**
 
 
• India has a large **informal economy**, where many individuals earn below the taxable limit.
 
• Lack of awareness about tax laws and compliance requirements in rural and semi-urban areas.
 
• Tax evasion and underreporting of income by certain individuals and entities.
 
 
 
• **Government Initiatives to Increase Tax Compliance:**
 
 
• The introduction of **faceless assessment** to make tax filing more transparent and less cumbersome.
 
• Implementation of GST (Goods and Services Tax) for better revenue tracking across sectors.
 
• Mandatory linking of PAN with Aadhaar to curb tax evasion.
 
• Awareness campaigns to educate citizens about the importance of filing income tax returns.
 
 
 
• **Role of Informal Sector:**
 
 
• A significant portion of India's workforce is engaged in the informal sector, which typically remains untaxed.
 
• Efforts to formalize the sector include schemes like **PM-KISAN** and digitization drives.
